about: Sentence Builder: three word cards; teams write one correct sentence that uses all three. Reveal shows an example sentence. M.1 present simple / everyday words, M.2 past, future, comparatives and linking words, M.3 conditionals, passives, relative clauses and linkers. Written for Kru. At least 50 per level, shuffled every game. A word may change form (cook → cooks).

intro.title: Sentence Builder
text: Write ONE sentence that uses all three words.

intro.title: Example
text: You can change the word a little: run → runs.
Add any other words you need.

example.big: My dog runs in the park every day.

intro.title: Win points
text: Write it on your board before the timer ends.

before.name: Question time
before.text: Write it as a question for +2!

before.name: Two sentences
before.text: Write a second sentence with the same words: +2

secret.name: Capitals + full stop
secret.text: +1 for a capital letter AND a full stop!

secret.name: First correct
secret.text: +2 for the first team with a correct sentence!
